It was first published in the September 2023 issue of ''[[Ciao]]'', released on August 3, 2023.<ref>[http://web.archive.org/web/20230820214346/https://www.shogakukan.co.jp/magazines/0613909123 ''Ciao'' September 2023 issue | Shogakukan] (Japanese; archived)</ref><ref>[https://twitter.com/kise_ricca/status/1686934995787771904 Ricca Kise on Twitter] (Japanese)</ref> It is eight pages long.
